newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Photo group net seen rising 18% yr/yr--paper.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Photo group net seen rising 18% yr/yr--paper.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd's group net profit is expected to rise 18 percent to about 86 billion yen in the year to March 31, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
The expected year-on-year rise is due to robust production of photographic film and paper at its Dutch unit, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
The paper said Fuji Photo's group sales in 1996/97 are expected to rise 13 percent year-on-year to 1.23 trillion yen.
It said the firm's 1996/97 parent current profit is also expected to rise four percent to about 120 billion yen.
Fuji Photo officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
